headline: Portland JSX Posts Record $9.4 Million Loss Amid Capital Market Weakness
summary: Private equity fund Portland JSX reported a net loss of US$9.4 million for its year-end, driven by steep valuation declines across its investment portfolio.
why: Publicly traded private equity funds are sensitive to equity market volatility and valuation markdowns in underlying assets.

impacts.name: Portland JSX
impacts.why: Weaker capital markets drive portfolio valuation markdowns and widen net losses.
